MediVena One-Care Push Button Safety Blood Collection Wing Sets, Pre-attached Holders, 21G/23G/25G, 12" Tube, 40/BX, 5BX/CS

The ONE-CARE® PUSH-BUTTON Safety Blood Collection Butterfly Set offers advantages for both healthcare professionals and patients, thanks to its push-button-controlled automatic needle retraction technology. Designed as a sterile, closed system for venous blood collection, the set features a push-button mechanism that can be activated with one hand while the needle is still in the vein, instantly retracting the needle into a protective housing; this prevents needlestick injuries and reduces the risk of blood exposure. It has luer adapter or pre-attached holder type.

This latex- and DEHP-free product is equipped with thin-wall technology and a lubricated cannula to ensure high flow rates and patient comfort.

One Hand Operation

Provides the ultimate protection for healthcare professionals with push button and automated needle retraction technology. It allows for one-hand activation of safety shield in-vein or immediately after the blood draw.

Features

  • Ultimate Protection: Push-button with automated needle retraction technology safeguards both healthcare professionals and patients.

  • Auto-Retractable Safety Mechanism: Press the button to retract the needle automatically into the shield.

  • One-Hand In-Vein Activation: Enables safe activation directly in-vein with one hand, reducing risk of needlestick injuries.

  • Non-Curl Tubing: Premium material prevents "coil memory" for smoother handling.

  • Ultra-Sharp Needle: Designed for maximum patient comfort.

  • Ergonomic, Enlarged Wings: Provide secure grip and convenient handling.

  • Enhanced Safety Cap: Improved cap design allows easy and safe removal.

  • High Fill Rate: Thin-Wall Technology with lubricated cannula needles ensures efficient blood flow.

  • Regulatory Compliant: Made from latex- and DEHP-free materials.

  • Cost-Effective: Delivers significant savings compared to major brands.

Medivena One-Care Press & Lock Safety Blood Collection Butterfly Sets. ONE-CARE PRESS & LOCK Safety Blood Collection Sets are simple to use, user-friendly, and cost-effective. The safety mechanism can be activated either while the needle is still in the vein or immediately after the procedure by pressing the side buttons and retracting the needle shield. An audible "click" confirms that the needle is securely locked. Featuring thin-walled cannulas with a tri-bevel tip, electropolished finish, and lubricant coating, these sets ensure higher tube fill rates and enhanced patient comfort. The DEHP-free, flexible tubing designed with low memory facilitates ease of use while preserving the chemical and physiological composition of the blood.

Features

  • DEPF-free, low memory and flexible tubing assists in handling and preserves the blood chemical and physiological composition
  • Thin-Wall Technology Canula provides for optimal flow and higher tube fill-rates
  • Transparent Tube Holder for better visibility of collection tubes filling up with blood,
    tube holders provided separately or pre-attached
  • Tri-bevel, ultra-sharp, electropolished and lubricated needle  for patient comfort
  • Ergonomic wing design permits improved positioning during application 
  • Multi-sampling, universal design Luer allows for tight fit to tube holders and multiple blood sample collection from one patient
  • PRESS & LOCK Safety Shield enables activation of safety shield in-vein or immediately after the blood draw.

MediVena Gluco-Care Safety Lancets Contact Activated, 21G to 30G, 100/BX, 50BX/CS, Sterile 

MediVena Gluco-Care Safety Lancets are ready-to-use devices suitable for obtaining capillary blood samples from fingertips and alternative sites, featuring needle gauges ranging from 21G to 30G and penetration depths from 1.8 mm to 2.8 mm. The contact-activated mechanism eliminates the need for manual needle exposure, while the integrated dual-spring system ensures consistent puncture depth and immediate needle retraction, thereby reducing the risk of needlestick injuries.

Features

Safe

  • Single-use mechanism prevents sharps injuries and reuse of the device

  • Fully enclosed housing ensures that needle is hidden before and after use

  • All lancets are Gamma-sterilized and protected with a sterility tab

Comfortable

  • Silicone-coated, ultra-thin needles ideally positioned during skin penetration with double-spring mechanism to reduce vibrations

  • Color-coded product versions to meet specific blood sample requirements and address a variety of patient skin types

  • Ergonomic design for comfortable grip and secure blood collection

Simple

  • Easy to use, intuitive operation in 3 steps only, no pre-loading required

  • Wide safety cap designed for easy removal - simply twist off the cap and pull it out

  • Optimal skin contact area for precise positioning on the desired test site and
